name: Phased festive gong cycle
desc: A brighter, faster lancaran-style colotomic frame: the gong ageng returns every two cycles, brakedrum kethuk drives underneath, and two handchime layers run a Reich phase (one at fast(64/63)) so the metal shimmer slowly slips and realigns over ~63 cycles. Peak throws in a sus_cymbal euclid rotation and masked handchime bursts for gong-kebyar sparkle.

code.full: stack(s("<gong ~>").gain(${gain}).room(${room}), s("gong2 ~ agogo ~ gong2 ~ agogo ~").gain(${gain}*.48).pan(cosine.range(.4,.6).slow(24)), s("handchimes*4").gain(${gain}*.3).pan(.4), s("handchimes*4").gain(${gain}*.26).fast(64/63).pan(.6), s("brakedrum*8").gain("[.26 .1 .18 .08]*2").pan(sine.range(.35,.65).slow(16))).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}).slow(32)).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<gong ~>").gain(${gain}).room(${room}), s("gong2 ~ agogo gong2 ~ agogo gong2 ~").gain(${gain}*.48).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(20)), s("handchimes*8").gain(${gain}*.3).pan(.4).mask("<1 1 1 0>"), s("handchimes*8").gain(${gain}*.26).fast(64/63).pan(.6), s("brakedrum*16").gain("[.26 .1 .18 .08]*4").pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(16)).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)), s("sus_cymbal(3,8,<0 2 4>)").gain(${gain}*.3).room(${room})).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.2).slow(24)).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
